headline: SILVER SURGES 2.4% to $76/oz as Sixth Straight Annual Structural Deficit Confirmed
snippet: Silver spot price jumped 2.41% to $76.24/oz on May 21, with the Silver Institute forecasting a 67-million-oz shortfall in 2026 — the sixth consecutive annual deficit — as solar panel and EV demand continues to outrun flat mine supply. Silver is up more than 150% over the past year.

headline: White Gold Corp IP Surveys Unlock New PORPHYRY Copper-Gold Targets in Yukon's Golden Heart
snippet: White Gold Corp.'s induced polarization surveys at Guilder and Mt. Hart in west-central Yukon have defined high-priority porphyry and epithermal copper-gold drill targets, expanding the company's 2026 drill pipeline in one of Canada's most active exploration districts.

headline: Gold Eases to $4,524 as Trump Signals US in 'Final Stages' of Iran Peace Talks
snippet: Gold slipped 0.42% to $4,524/oz on May 21 as the prospect of a US-Iran peace agreement reduced geopolitical risk premium. The metal remains up more than $1,200 from year-ago levels, with J.P. Morgan maintaining a Q4 2026 average target of $5,055/oz.

headline: AYA GOLD Boumadine Hits 890 g/t AgEq Over 51.5m — Strongest Grade-Thickness Intercept in Project History
snippet: Aya Gold & Silver (TSX: AYA) drilled 890 g/t silver equivalent over 51.5 metres at Boumadine, Morocco — including a 1,504 g/t AgEq core of 19.3m — the best intercept in project history on a grade-thickness basis, located just 70m below the current pit shell. The company has drilled 69,209 metres year-to-date with 11 rigs active.

headline: Marimaca Copper STEP-OUT Drilling Confirms Scale at Pampa Medina: Multiple Stacked Mantos Above 2% Cu
snippet: Marimaca Copper (TSX: MARI, ASX: MC2) released new assay results from step-out drilling at Pampa Medina in Chile, with multiple broad intervals returning above 2% copper across a 3km x 1.5km area of interest. Results validate the sediment-hosted manto model and support a high-grade central zone ahead of a maiden resource estimate.

headline: China Lithium Carbonate Eases From 2-Year High as VAT-Driven Surge Prompts Producer Restarts
snippet: Chinese lithium carbonate pulled back to CNY 191,000/t from its May 13 peak of CNY 200,500 — a 78% surge triggered by China's April 1 VAT export rebate cut — as higher prices incentivized previously-idled producers to restart. Global lithium demand is projected to reach 1.5 million metric tons in 2026.

headline: NdPr Oxide DROPS 21% in April to $99/kg After 105% Q1 Rally — Consolidation or Warning Sign?
snippet: Neodymium-praseodymium oxide corrected to $99.61/kg in April after a 105% Q1 2026 surge, driven by profit-taking and inventory adjustment. Analysts see it as a healthy pause: NdPr remains up ~88% year-to-date and above all major Western producers' cost base, with EV and wind turbine demand still accelerating.

headline: 55:1 and Falling: Why Silver Compressing the Gold-Silver Ratio Signals the REAL Move Is Still Ahead
snippet: The gold-silver ratio compressed from 62:1 to below 55:1 in a single week in May 2026 — one of the fastest moves in years — as silver's industrial bid repriced following the US-China tariff truce. Analysts argue the structural story is early innings and ratio-based entry discipline beats chasing headline prices near $76.

headline: Standard Uranium Upgrades Athabasca Geophysics, PREPS Inaugural Drill at Davidson River
snippet: Standard Uranium has upgraded its geophysical dataset at the Davidson River project in Saskatchewan's Athabasca Basin and is preparing an inaugural drill program targeting high-grade uranium mineralization, as spot prices hold above $83/lb and institutional interest in Athabasca Basin juniors rebuilds following Q1 volatility.

headline: Gold, Silver, and Copper Are All Bullish Right Now — Here's the Case for Each Metal
snippet: GoldSeek's multi-metal market update makes the concurrent bull case for gold above $4,500, silver in a structural deficit, and copper benefiting from AI infrastructure and energy transition demand — arguing that the typical inverse relationship between safe-haven and industrial metals is breaking down in 2026.
